description:
[Reports] List what a custom report can use on this account: datasets (interview results, invitations, position pipeline, ATS pipeline, credits, coaching sessions - only those the account and your role include), their dimensions (group by / conditions, with allowed values) and measures. Call this first: a report definition may only use ids listed here. Custom reports are switched on per account by JobMojito; while they are off, every report tool is refused with 403 'Custom reports are not enabled for this account.' Tell the user to contact JobMojito rather than retrying.

Everything a custom report may use on this account: the datasets (interview results, invitations, position pipeline, ATS pipeline, credits, coaching sessions - only those your account and role include), their dimensions (group by / filter) and measures (numbers), block types, condition operators and period presets. Read this before writing a report definition: ids not listed here are refused.

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

name: list_report_fields

datasets.description: Datasets you may use: id, label, description, snapshot (ignores the period), and fields: id, kind (dimension | measure), type, label, description, values (allowed values of a text dimension), grains (date), table_only, format.

title: List report datasets and fields
